name: FORTLINE [ONE SHOT🎯]
desc:
🔫🚌 FORTLINE — Battle Royale with Building 🚌🔫
Drop from the Battle Bus, loot, build, and be the last one standing.

🆕 SKINS + CRATES UPDATE
🎨 Collect character Skins and Weapon Wraps
📦 Open Crates to unlock new Wraps, Auras and Kill Effects
🏆 Season 1 Battle Pass — 30 tiers of rewards
🚌 Ride the Battle Bus and glide down with your umbrella
🗝️ Find Chests across the map and open them with Keys
🎁 Daily Rewards, Quests and a Starter Pack for new players

⚔️ THE FIGHT
🛠️ Fast-paced PvP with building mechanics
🏅 18 Ranks — Bronze I to Unreal
💰 Earn XP and Coins from kills, headshots, bounties and streaks
🎯 Bounties — hunt the top players for big rewards
🏁 Kill Race events with special loadouts
👥 Squad up with friends
📊 Global leaderboards

🎮 CONTROLS
[Q] Build · [V] Unlock Camera · [M] Settings
📱 Works on PC, mobile, tablet and console

⭐+35% Health for Premium Players
🎉 Free Private Servers
⭐ Like and Favorite so you don't miss the next update!
